confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer prices follow Wroclaw cost-of-living averages updated 15 October 2026. Cocktail pricing uses a current collaborative city estimate with a small sample; wine is estimated at about 1.25 times a local draft beer because a current restaurant glass average was unavailable. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates without live listing checks and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wroclaw is a large regional Polish city with domestic and visitor demand; food and drink use Wroclaw-specific averages, while accommodation reflects a mid-sized Central European tourist city.
